title: VTC: add active/dominant speaker signaling
description: Jitsi and Zoom surface active-speaker detection (who is currently talking) for speaker-view, spotlight, and Last-N tile optimization. The draft has speakerTimeMs (cumulative) but no active-speaker indicator. Add either an activeSpeakerId field on VTCCall (server-set, updated by media layer) or a VTCActiveSpeakerEvent ephemeral event. The event approach is better — active speaker changes frequently.
close_reason: VTCActiveSpeakerEvent defined as part of the in-call ephemeral events block in issue .2.
